explanation: Refused. For eta electroproduction (e p -> e' p eta) the physical threshold is W_th = m_p + m_eta ≈ 1.4861 GeV, not the Delta resonance mass (~1.232 GeV). Requested W = 1.45 GeV is ~36 MeV below threshold; the final state cannot be produced. EXCLURAD preflight confirms FAIL: W below 1.4861 GeV and outside the EtaMAID-2023 lookup table ([1.4856, 6.0]). No input file was written because the kinematics are physically impossible. If a near-threshold eta run is intended, use W >= ~1.496 GeV (and note the table starts at 1.4856 GeV, with runs near 1.486 GeV being most likely to hang / return silent N/A per the eta channel quirks — a smoke test is required). Beam energy (default 6.53 GeV for CLAS12) is irrelevant until W passes threshold.
